_about: Every public-domain Thomas Manton (1620-1677) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is the Nisbet Complete Works (22 vols, 1870-1875, memoir by William Harris). CCEL has nine volumes as clean ThML (1-8 and 20); the other thirteen are held as Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted, from one scan series whose volume numbers were each read off the title page. One slug per volume, whichever source holds it. No Gutenberg Manton found.
